# @trysac/api-versioning

> Framework-agnostic API version resolution from path or header, with RFC 9745 Deprecation, RFC 8594 Sunset and Link headers and 410 after sunset TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation and usage example
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how tests and coverage work
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records
